svg.title: Commercial fisher — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as commercial fisher, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A hanging fish with a triangular tail and eye sits apart from a long fishing line ending in an open curved hook. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
